decisions.decision: Approve the 47-invariant manifest and its sharpened statements.
decisions.note: The census stays at 47 invariants in 8 families. The errata are mapped into existing invariants; no invariant was added, removed, merged or renumbered.

decisions.decision: Approve the four-role ownership matrix, with PR-0 holding normative text only.
decisions.note: Every invariant declares a normative, enforcement, persistence and test owner. Where persistence is n/a it carries an explicit note saying why.

decisions.decision: Adopt the single authority domain constraint for Phase 0: one authoritative database, one host, recorded in the deployment note.
decisions.note: FE-6 adds that capacity 1 within the domain is measured in in-flight invocations, not in database claims alone.

decisions.decision: Approve the total order, the four-column dependency table and migrations v1 to v7.
decisions.note: Approved as drawn. PR-E depends on PR-D as its schema predecessor as well as its merge predecessor.

decisions.decision: Approve the journal state machine, the ambiguity policy, the registrability rule and the crash table.
decisions.note: FE-4 inserts a probe-only reconciliation state between UNKNOWN and any further execution. FE-5 makes abandonment an unknown truth, not a success.

decisions.decision: Approve the trust-boundary split: PR-C identity, PR-G transport, PR-D source policy, PR-F authority, PR-E effect.
decisions.note: FE-1 clarifies that authority is proved by authenticated issuance context and a durable principal record, never by a field inside the message.

decisions.decision: Approve the 25-field envelope, the action matrix, lossless identity and the evidence snapshot model.
decisions.note: FE-2 makes use_limit explicit in every kind and turns Git provenance into an all-or-nothing group. FE-3 requires the current snapshot to be recomputed at redemption rather than merely re-checked for existence.

decisions.decision: Approve severity unification, risk-label separation, R3, R4 and the no-default disposition rule.
Approve the review budgets: 2 rounds per slice, 3 for PR-F, 1 for PR-I, 2 for PR-0.
decisions.note: Approved, with R6 as the load-bearing rule: a finding naming a rule the specification lacks is a specification gap and stops the slice.

decisions.decision: Approve the test triage method and the obligation to produce the 141-row mapping inside PR-0.
decisions.note: Approved as drawn. The mapping is spec/manifests/test-triage.json and it is exactly 141 rows.

decisions.decision: Authorise opening PR-0 as a specification-only PR including a non-runtime validator, its tests and its CI wiring.
decisions.note: Granted. PR-0 may be created, committed, pushed and opened. Merging it is not authorised.

decisions.decision: How to support a second independent authority domain, should one ever exist.
decisions.note: Revisit before any second host is introduced. Not a Phase 0 question and not a Phase 1A entry condition.

decisions.decision: Whether medium and low debt carried out of Phase 0 blocks Phase 1A.
decisions.note: Decided at the Phase 1A entry gate. It does not block the Phase 0 completion gate.

decisions.decision: Where the Phase-1A provider lifecycle specification lives: its own slice, or inside another approved specification slice.
decisions.note: Decided at the Phase 1A entry gate. FE-8 removes it from the Phase 0 completion gate: Phase 0 may complete with D14 undecided.

standing_authorizations.subject: PR #1 closure
standing_authorizations.note: PR #1 stays open, unmerged and unmodified. Closing it is step 5 of the PR #1 ordering and is requested separately.

standing_authorizations.subject: PR-0 merge
standing_authorizations.note: PR-0 may be opened and reviewed. Merging it requires a separate Founder decision.

standing_authorizations.subject: Phase 1A implementation
standing_authorizations.note: No real adapter implementation may begin until the Phase 1A entry gate is satisfied and Phase 1A is separately authorised.
